decisions.reason: Removing the kerning requirement does not alter or obsolete the independently established Hero V and É accent peak-alignment rules. The project-ending language does not establish a candidate-specific attribute modification that can be propagated as a MODIFY.
The kerning removal does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes.
The common-baseline rule is independent of cohesive kerning and remains semantically unchanged by removal of the kerning requirement.
The source does not change acceptable proof formats or report a new format requirement; its request for editable working files is a separate delivery matter.
